model_output.cross_horizon_summary: The supplied evidence supports a low-confidence downside bias over 12h and 72h, concentrated in ETH and broader altcoin participation; BTC may remain relatively resilient. Weak breadth, seller-led hourly trading and modest liquidity contraction outweigh—but do not eliminate—stabilization evidence. At 168h, persistence is insufficiently established to distinguish continued weakness from recovery, so NO_EDGE is appropriate. Capitalization transmission is weak and proxy-only, not confirmed rotation. These are descriptive, non-binding forecasts: they confer no portfolio execution authority, and neither the structural prior nor the entry observer determines the forecast.
